Academic and Faculty Affairs

Faculty Workload

The university Faculty Workload policy guides assignment of faculty effort through the creation of annual Statements of Expectation.

The Faculty Workload policy establishes guidelines for development of college or unit faculty workload policies and practices.

Responsible Executive: Provost
Responsible Office: Vice Provost for Faculty Affairs
Effective Date: April 24, 2023
Contact: Vice Provost for Faculty Affairs
